human_source_utterance:
I explicitly authorize the following scientific research action ONLY:

stage128-m2-boundary-month-equity-return-design-freeze

Repository:

abtinasg/papermali

Expected starting main:

b25804ab764258c846b391f4823f089552c855e3

This authorization is LIMITED to:

- formalizing;
- documenting;
- testing;
- and freezing

the approved D2 Gregorian M2 equity-return design amendment.

It does NOT authorize:

- canonical M2 Gate rerun;
- M2 incremental evaluation;
- model fitting;
- prediction generation;
- hyperparameter tuning or retuning;
- feature discovery;
- target-based design comparison;
- final-test access;
- M3;
- M4;
- full-development refit;
- winner selection;
- merge without later explicit authorization.

==================================================
SCIENTIFIC DECISION BEING AUTHORIZED
==================================================

Freeze D2 as the new PRIMARY M2 equity-return specification:

BOUNDARY_MONTH_ASOF_TRAILING_EQUITY_RETURN

Calendar convention:

GREGORIAN

This choice is scientific and prospective from this point forward.

It is NOT chosen because it crossed the coverage threshold.

Rationale:

- the canonical M2 market-time axis uses Gregorian/ISO dates;
- TSETMC dEven and the existing market-data pipeline operate on the
  Gregorian date axis;
- the frozen 12-calendar-month W uses datetime.date / Gregorian arithmetic;
- D2 preserves W, t0, T*, daily-return adjacency, realized volatility and
  Amihud exactly;
- D2 changes only how the two observed adjusted-price endpoints used for the
  cumulative equity-return construct are selected;
- the Jalali-boundary diagnostic materially changed eligibility but did not
  change return values among dual-usable observations, so it remains a
  pre-lock diagnostic and is NOT adopted.

==================================================
HISTORICAL STATE MUST REMAIN PRESERVED
==================================================

The original D0 specification remains a historical scientific record.

Do NOT rewrite history to make D2 appear ex ante.

Record explicitly:

D0 was the original frozen equity-return specification.

D0 required adjusted_close at exact t0 and exact T*.

Authoritative TSETMC evidence showed:

D0 equity_return_window coverage =
269 / 666 = 0.4039039039

realized_volatility =
576 / 666 = 0.8648648649

amihud_illiquidity =
576 / 666 = 0.8648648649

D0 common sample =
269 / 666 = 0.4039039039

D0 therefore returned:

FAIL_M2_DATA_GATE

The subsequent official-calendar investigation established that the failure
was not a retrieval/database defect and that the D0 implementation conformed
to the then-frozen contract.

D2 was considered only after predictor-data feasibility was observed.

No M2 model, prediction, PR-AUC, target-driven design comparison or final-test
result was inspected before this D2 decision.

Use wording equivalent to:

"prospectively locked after predictor-only feasibility assessment and before
outcome/model evaluation"

Do NOT describe D2 as:

"ex-ante pre-registered."

==================================================
D2 FROZEN FORMULA CONTRACT
==================================================

Retain the existing canonical pair-specific W unchanged.

For each development pair:

- pair_cutoff remains unchanged;
- T* remains unchanged;
- t0 remains unchanged;
- W date set remains unchanged;
- W remains the existing 12-calendar-month shared information window;
- trading-day semantics remain unchanged;
- zero-trade InstrumentCalendar days remain in W;
- daily-return adjacency remains unchanged.

Define:

START BOUNDARY

Identify the Gregorian calendar month containing t0.

Within W, select:

d_start =
the FIRST trading observation on or after t0,
within that SAME Gregorian calendar month,
with a valid official corporate-action-adjusted adjusted_close.

If none exists:

equity_return_D2 = unavailable.

END BOUNDARY

Identify the Gregorian calendar month containing T*.

Within W, select:

d_end =
the LAST trading observation on or before T*,
within that SAME Gregorian calendar month,
with a valid official corporate-action-adjusted adjusted_close.

If none exists:

equity_return_D2 = unavailable.

Then:

R_D2 =
P_adjusted(d_end) / P_adjusted(d_start) - 1

No annualization.

No rescaling to exactly 365 days.

No interpolation.

No extrapolation.

No forward fill.

No backward fill.

No imputation.

No raw/unadjusted close substitution.

No synthetic adjusted prices.

==================================================
126-RETURN QUALITY FLOOR
==================================================

Keep the existing requirement:

usable_daily_return_count >= 126

Use the EXISTING frozen daily-return validity logic.

Do NOT change:

- return construction;
- adjacency;
- missing-price handling;
- minimum count;
- zero-trade treatment.

If usable_daily_return_count < 126:

D2 remains unavailable even if both boundary prices exist.

==================================================
OTHER M2 FEATURES
==================================================

Freeze as unchanged:

realized_volatility

and:

amihud_illiquidity

They must retain:

- the same W;
- the same formulas;
- the same minimum 126 rules;
- the same PIT constraints;
- the same zero-traded-value treatment;
- the same no-imputation rules.

D2 must NOT change either feature.

The M2 primary block after this design amendment is therefore:

1. boundary-month as-of trailing equity return
2. realized volatility
3. Amihud illiquidity

No fourth primary market feature.

zero_trade_day_ratio_W remains:

DESCRIPTIVE MICROSTRUCTURE / ELIGIBILITY DIAGNOSTIC ONLY

It is NOT added to primary M2.

==================================================
CONSTRUCT TERMINOLOGY
==================================================

Primary paper-facing name:

Boundary-Month As-of Trailing Equity Return

First-use explanatory wording may say:

"an approximately 12-month as-of cumulative equity return"

Do NOT call it an exact 12-month return without qualification.

Record the previously observed effective-span diagnostic:

minimum ≈ 342 days
median ≈ 364 days
maximum ≈ 366 days

These values are historical predictor-only feasibility evidence,
not a new selection rule.

Do NOT add a minimum effective-span threshold.

==================================================
GREGORIAN CALENDAR LOCK
==================================================

Freeze Gregorian boundary membership.

Do NOT rerun alternative-calendar searches to choose the primary definition.

Record the pre-lock Jalali diagnostic transparently:

- Gregorian D2 usable = 539 / 666
- Jalali-boundary diagnostic usable = 459 / 666
- 86 / 666 observations changed usability status
- 456 pairs were usable under both
- among those 456, return-value difference = 0

Interpretation:

calendar convention affects eligibility/sample definition,
not the measured return where both are eligible.

Jalali was diagnostic only.

It is NOT adopted.

Do not choose Gregorian because 539 clears the Gate.

Choose it because it is coherent with the frozen Gregorian market-time axis
and preserves the original W construct.

==================================================
FEASIBILITY RESULTS — RECORD, DO NOT RESELECT
==================================================

The predictor-only feasibility study previously observed:

D0:
269 / 666
coverage 0.4039039039

D1 diagnostic upper bound:
576 / 666
coverage 0.8648648649

D2 Gregorian:
539 / 666
coverage 0.8093093093

D2 three-feature common:
539 / 666
coverage 0.8093093093

D3 monthly-as-of:
555 / 666
coverage 0.8333333333
common 553 / 666

D3 is NOT adopted.

Reason:

D3 breaks the shared M2 information-window construct:
its return horizon differs from the volatility/Amihud horizon across the
usable observations and discards recent pre-cutoff information.

Do not include D3 in primary M2 merely because its coverage is larger.

D1 remains diagnostic only and must never become a scientific specification.

==================================================
D2 FAILURE TAXONOMY TO FREEZE
==================================================

Record the predictor-only feasibility taxonomy:

D2 unusable total = 127 / 666

Observed non-exclusive causes:

LT126_VALID_RETURNS = 90
NO_START_BOUNDARY_PRICE = 55
NO_END_BOUNDARY_PRICE = 17

Retain combinations as a descriptive audit.

Do NOT change D2 to recover those observations.

No extra boundary tolerance.

No 14-day / 21-day / 31-day optimization.

No cross-month fallback.

No tuning to reach a higher coverage figure.

==================================================
TEMPORAL AVAILABILITY LIMITATION
==================================================

Record that D2 availability was temporally heterogeneous in the feasibility
study.

Observed fold coverage:

fold1_train =
173 / 245 = 0.706122...

fold1_validation =
159 / 205 = 0.775610...

fold2_train =
332 / 450 = 0.737778...

fold2_validation =
207 / 216 = 0.958333...

This is a limitation/diagnostic.

Do NOT create a new fold-specific Gate threshold.

Do NOT change D2 to equalize temporal coverage.

==================================================
POST-LOCK ELIGIBILITY AUDIT CONTRACT
==================================================

Freeze that AFTER this design lock, but BEFORE interpreting M2 predictive
results, an eligibility audit must compare D2-eligible vs D2-ineligible
observations on predictor-side characteristics.

At minimum:

prediction cohort / year
industry
firm size
zero_trade_day_ratio_W
market activity / traded-value diagnostics
M1 predictor availability

Use standardized mean differences where appropriate.

If using |SMD| >= 0.10, label it only as a descriptive imbalance flag,
not a pass/fail exclusion rule.

Do NOT remove rows based on SMD.

The future distress-rate comparison between eligible and ineligible cases may
be performed only after this design is locked and must not retroactively alter
the design.

==================================================
GOVERNANCE / FILES
==================================================

Create a NEW scientific branch from exact main:

b25804ab764258c846b391f4823f089552c855e3

Suggested branch:

stage128-m2-boundary-month-return-design-freeze

Create ONE PR.

Do not reuse PR #66/#67/#68 branches.

This PR should be a DESIGN-FREEZE / CONTRACT PR.

It must not execute the new Gate.

Create clear source-derived freeze artifacts for:

- authorization scope;
- D2 formula contract;
- calendar convention;
- feasibility provenance;
- frozen exclusions/prohibitions;
- eligibility-audit contract;
- Stage127 historical D0 outcome reference;
- next authorized/not-authorized state.

Do not mutate the historical Stage125 contract to pretend D2 was always there.

Prefer a new Stage128 amendment artifact that references and supersedes only
the D0 equity-return measurement component for future M2 Gate execution.

Preserve historical artifacts byte-for-byte.

==================================================
TESTS
==================================================

Tests must verify at minimum:

- same canonical W before/after D2;
- same t0;
- same T*;
- same trading-day sequence;
- same daily-return count;
- same realized volatility;
- same Amihud;
- Gregorian boundary semantics;
- first valid adjusted price within start boundary month;
- last valid adjusted price within end boundary month;
- no cross-month fallback;
- <126 remains unavailable;
- no imputation;
- no raw-close substitution;
- no change to final-test lock;
- no model invocation;
- no canonical Gate execution in the freeze task;
- historical D0 Gate remains FAIL and unchanged.

Tests may use development-side/synthetic fixtures only.

Do not access final-test values.

==================================================
RESEARCH POINTERS
==================================================

The D2 design-freeze action may become the newly completed research action only
after its own PR is audited and later explicitly merged.

Do NOT mark:

M2 Gate PASS

in this task.

Do NOT mark:

M2 admitted for modeling

in this task.

Do NOT authorize:

stage128-m2-d2-gate-rerun

or equivalent successor automatically.

After the freeze PR is complete, the next action should remain a future,
separately authorized canonical D2 Gate execution.

==================================================
VERSION CONTROL
==================================================

Additive commits only.

No amend.
No rebase.
No force push.

Do NOT merge the new PR.

Do NOT enable auto-merge.

Use:

abtinasg <abtinasg@gmail.com>

for new commits.

==================================================
FINAL RESPONSE
==================================================

Report:

1. starting main SHA
2. new branch
3. authorization artifact

24. PR OPEN / UNMERGED

Required values for this task:

target values accessed = 0
model fits = 0
predictions = 0
final-test access = 0
canonical Gate executions = 0
canonical Gate changed = NO
M2 admitted = NO

Then STOP.

Do NOT merge.
Do NOT execute D2 Gate.

The next scientific action — Gregorian D2 design amendment/freeze — is
separate and is NOT authorized by this merge.
